name: arc_challenge
description: ARC Challenge is the hard partition of the AI2 Reasoning Challenge: a set of natural-science multiple-choice questions designed to require reasoning and multi-step problem solving beyond simple retrieval. It measures a model's ability to perform complex textual scientific reasoning typically encountered in grade-school and middle-school science exams. The questions are intentionally difficult for retrieval-based methods and are used to benchmark reasoning advances in language models.
reputation: Widely used benchmark for testing advanced scientific and multi-step reasoning in language models; considered a standard hard test set in the QA/reasoning community.
